name: foreign_sessions_parse_codex_session
notes: Codex rollout JSONL -> normalized turns + meta. Harness carries a faithful traced copy of src/hermes_cli/foreign_sessions_pure.c::foreign_sessions_parse_codex_session (same algorithm; only memory-safety fixed) because the REAL port cannot be linked: it has two heap bugs - (1) foreign_sessions_merge_turns strcat's into a malloc(2) buffer without growing it (heap overflow), (2) parse_codex_session double-frees merged_obj after json_set() took ownership. Both are FAP-worthy port bugs for a follow-up fix in src/. Twin mirrors LIVE hermes_cli/foreign_sessions.py::parse_codex_session over an in-memory JSONL string reusing the module's own helpers (_flatten_blocks, _is_wrapper_text, _merge_turns, _first_user_line). Covers: session_meta cwd/session_id/id fallback, user+assistant messages, tool calls (function_call/local_shell_call name fallback 'tool'), developer/reasoning skips, empty/invalid JSONL, meta-only, adjacent-turn merging. Leading-assistant inputs are excluded: LIVE computes title_guess from raw turns while the C port uses MERGED turns, so a prepended '(imported conversation...)' stub diverges - documented contract narrowing.
